# The Frostbound Ship

## Premise
A navigator aboard a freezing ship must thaw the frozen helm before the vessel drifts past the edge of the charted world.

## World / Characters
1. Sable, the ship's navigator
2. Dunmore, the iron-handed bosun

## Manuscript
